name: Desktop
description: Desktop conveniences: clipboard, audio, media, notifications, app launcher.
author: PAI

capabilities.confirmationReason: Reading clipboard contents can be sensitive. Please confirm that you want to read the clipboard.
Writing to the clipboard can be sensitive. Please confirm that you want to write to the clipboard.

capabilities.description: Play an audio file or URL in the background.
Speak text via the system TTS engine.

capabilities.confirmationReason: Reading desktop notifications can be sensitive. Please confirm that you want to read the notifications.
capabilities.description: List current desktop notifications (DE-dependent; returns hint if unavailable).

capabilities.confirmationReason: Dismissing desktop notifications can be sensitive. Please confirm that you want to dismiss the notifications.
capabilities.description: Dismiss all desktop notifications (via dunstctl or similar).
Launch a desktop app or open a file/URL. To open a local file use url with file:// scheme (e.g. 'file:///home/user/image.jpg'). To launch an app by name use the app field.
capabilities.confirmationReason: Launching applications or opening URLs can be sensitive. Please confirm that you want to proceed.

app.description: Application name to launch (e.g., 'firefox', 'eog', 'spotify'). Do NOT include file arguments here — use the url field for files.

url.description: URL or local file to open with the default handler. For local files use file:// scheme, e.g. 'file:///home/chethan/Pictures/image.jpg'. For web URLs use https://.
